source_text: Omnis adeps Domini est; non comedetis. Pinguedo gloriae Deo. Cor pinguem misericordiae. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Every fat of-Lord is; not you-will-eat. Fatness of-glory to-God. Heart fat of-mercy. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[All fat is the Lord’s; you shall not eat it >> Bible:Leviticus 7:23-25]]. Give glory’s richness to God; keep a heart rich in mercy. Homilia V CLOSEOUT. Amen.
